text.p: MobileMedia Corp said Monday it did not make interest payments on its 9-3/8 percent senior subordinated notes due November 1, 2007, in order to conserve cash from operations.
The paging and personal communications services company said it is in talks with lenders and continues to work on a business plan to solve its operational problems.
The business plan will serve as the basis for restructuring talks with bank lenders and bondholders, the company said.
MobileMedia said it has retained Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette as financial advisor to review MobileMedia's strategic alternatives and to assist in developing a plan to restructure debt.
The paging company also established a restructuring committee to oversee its restructuring efforts.
